producer: v4/dev.py (engines, evaluate, decide), v4/heldout_gen.py (seal only; no score)

controls.columns_shuffled: not applicable: the kernel orders columns by content hash, so the released order cannot reach the engines

metric_defs.precision_half: DV-1 precision of the half-coverage view, out-of-fold confidence (kernel/v3.scored)
metric_defs.ece: expected calibration error of the DV-1 answers (score/calib.ece)
metric_defs.ges_directed_f1: directed F1 of the knob's GES output alone (score/graph.directed_f1)
metric_defs.ges_skeleton_f1: adjacency F1 of the knob's GES output (score/graph.coords S)

orientation_rule: AB-01 expectation rule: undecided pairs oriented at random, seed crc32(file name) (score/graph.py)
